claudexor — harness-agnostic AI coding control plane (v6.0.0)

Usage:
  claudexor init                            Scaffold repo-local config (.claudexor/config.yaml)
  claudexor doctor [--harness <id>] [--all]   Detect + conformance-test harnesses
  claudexor project list | register <root> | relink <id> <root> | remove <id> [--purge-trashed-threads] | outputs <id> [path]   Manage the durable v2 project registry
  claudexor ask "<question>" [opts]         Read-only answer/explanation route (--deep-scan widens to a multi-scout research sweep)
  claudexor agent "<prompt>" [opts]         Run a task (default mode: agent; internal model review is opt-in)
  claudexor best-of "<prompt>" [--n N]      Best-of-N run (agent --n) with cross-family review
  claudexor plan "<prompt>" [--council [--n N]]   Read-only planning report (--council: multi-harness drafts merged into one plan)
  claudexor create "<prompt>"               Create-from-scratch (agent --create)
  claudexor review --diff <file> | --evidence-dir <path> --artifacts-dir <path> ...   Reviewer-panel review of a diff or sealed frozen packet
  claudexor inspect <run_id>                Inspect a run's decision + artifacts
  claudexor follow <run_id> [--json]        Live-tail a daemon run (replay + push; answer questions in the TTY)
  claudexor retry <run_id>                  Exact Retry with the immutable original request and fresh preflight
  claudexor run-again <run_id>              Print an editable draft copied from a prior run
  claudexor thread history <id> [--limit N] [--cursor C | --before ID | --after ID | --around ID] [--json]   Read bounded thread history, one complete-prompt part, the thread's exact export, or its retirement state; never starts a daemon
    claudexor thread prompt <id> <turn-id> [--offset N] [--max-bytes N] --json   Read a UTF-8 prompt part (including runless refusals).
    claudexor thread export <id> --out <dir> [--expected-store-id ID] [--json]   Copy the thread's exact closure into a new directory, hashing every byte; exit 1 when partial.
    claudexor thread retirement <id> [--operation-id ID] [--expected-store-id ID] [--json]   Read retirement state and one operation's bound outcome.
  claudexor thread-retire <id> --export <dir> [--operation-id ID] [--json]   Purge a thread now if that verified export still matches its finished closure; never starts a daemon
    claudexor thread-retire <id> --abandon --operation-id ID [--json]   Settle an unanswered retirement operation so it can never accept.
  claudexor next-message '<DeferredMessageCall JSON>' --json   Create, replace or clear one operator-owned deferred message with its idempotency key
  claudexor next-message-read <draft-id> --json   Read bounded deferred content and exact predecessor/successor handles without dispatch
  claudexor task-group-runs <uuid> [--limit N] [--state S] [--cursor C] [--expected-store-id ID] --json   Read one retained task group page in current served generations; never starts a daemon
  claudexor runs-wait --targets-json '<array>' [--wait-ms <ms>] [--json | --json-stream]   Observe attention from 1..1000 existing jobs/runs once; never starts a daemon
  claudexor apply <run_id> [--mode ...]     Apply a run's WorkProduct (apply|commit|branch|pr|--dry-run)
  claudexor decision <run_id> <action-flags>   Record a run decision: --accept-risk|--override|--revert|--discard|--taken|--accept-clean-patch [--apply-mode m]|--rerun --feedback "<text>"
  claudexor store-identity --json           Read the running daemon's durable store id; save it with an import key before use
  claudexor upload-import <absolute-host-file> --expected-store-id <id> --idempotency-key <key> [--request-json '{"kind":...,"mime":...,"name":...}'] --json   Import one file on this host as a ready attachment under a saved store id and key; replays need no source
  claudexor upload-create --request-json '<object>' --idempotency-key <key> --json   Create an ordinary attachment upload; save its caller-owned key/body
  claudexor upload-import-local <upload_id> <absolute-h
